title: Camille Howard from the 'Million Dollar Secret' record
summary: Camille Howard, who worked with Roy Milton and played on Humes's 'Million Dollar Secret' record, has reportedly retired for religious reasons. Humes was looking for her and thinks a woman pianist would be fun.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Fancy that. Well listen, there's another gal but the names escape me. I think you can help me. First of all there was Camille Howard, do you remember?
She worked with Roy Melton, didn't she?
Oh the one, 'The Million Dollar Secret'.
Yeah the one that Gene Norman Presents at The Shrine.
Yeah. Well you know Roy Melton told me that she was very religious. I think they're Mormons. And I think he told me she just retired from the business.
Yeah, that's what I heard because I was looking for her.

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Really? I think it would be kind of fun to have a gal pianist, wouldn't it?
